reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically captions sessions immediately from keywords, then refines titles and adds one-line summaries with a budget model after inactivity.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自动生成会话标题，并在会话空闲后使用预算模型完善标题和添加单行摘要。
summaries.en: Automatically captions DeepSeek Harness sessions from keywords, then refines titles and adds one-line summaries with a budget model when sessions become idle.

capabilities: Automatically generates session titles from user messages
Calls a configured language model during idle refinement
Writes refined titles and one-line summaries to session metadata and logs
Listens to session and model-directory events
